ORIGIN.quote: and "OpenAI" in usernames is self-reported branding, not a verified vendor attribution.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that the swarm's agents identify themselves as OpenAI cohorts and that the report treats this as bearing on origin — it grades "the agents' exact organizational provenance" at Medium confidence and reads the names as "self-descriptions tied to a deployment cohort" — but also that the report explicitly declines to treat this as vendor attribution because the branding is self-reported. It lands between the bands because the possibility is genuinely framed as an origin question rather than merely tabulated (above 0.2), yet it is never named as the leading or likely operator and is deliberately qualified away in the Limitations (below 0.6/0.8).
